measures.id: Knox County Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal) – Senior Citizens Services
measures.title: Knox County senior citizens services tax levy (renewal)
measures.summary: Renews a Knox County tax to provide or maintain senior citizens services or facilities for Knox County senior citizens. The county auditor estimates it will collect $1,155,031 a year at up to 0.79 mill, or $28 for each $100,000 of market value, for 5 years starting in 2027, first due in 2028.
measures.yesMeans: The senior citizens services levy would continue for 5 more years.
measures.noMeans: The senior citizens services levy would not be renewed.
